def reward(s: object) -> dict[str, object]:
    from typing import cast
    import effectful.handlers.jax.numpy as n
    from experiments.panda_leap_pickup import PickupScene
    from robotl.ops.losses import KeepBelow
    x = cast(PickupScene, s)
    palm = x.assembly.robot.hand.origin.pose.pos
    goal = x.assembly.obj.pose @ n.asarray((0.018, -0.16, 0.45))
    return {"moving_palm_goal": KeepBelow(n.sqrt(n.sum((palm-goal)**2)), 0.025)}

def reachable_neck(s: object) -> dict[str, object]:
    from typing import cast
    import effectful.handlers.jax.numpy as n
    from experiments.panda_leap_pickup import PickupScene
    from robotl.ops.losses import KeepBelow

    x = cast(PickupScene, s)
    palm = x.assembly.robot.hand.origin.pose.pos
    goal = x.assembly.obj.pose @ n.asarray((0.018, -0.045, 0.350))
    distance = n.sqrt(n.sum((palm - goal) ** 2))
    return {"palm_at_reachable_neck": KeepBelow(distance, 0.025)}

def reward(s: object) -> dict[str, object]:
    from typing import cast
    import effectful.handlers.jax.numpy as n
    from experiments.panda_leap_pickup import PickupScene
    from robotl.ops.losses import KeepAbove, Minimize
    x = cast(PickupScene, s)
    load = x.contact_observations["hand_normal_load_N"].get().x[0]
    axis = x.assembly.obj.tip.pose.pos - x.assembly.obj.base.pose.pos
    cosine = axis[2] / n.sqrt(n.sum(axis*axis) + 1e-12)
    return {"lift": x.task_losses["whole_clearance"], "carry": KeepAbove(load, 9.2), "upright": Minimize(1.0-cosine)}
